title: Agents Run Longer; Boundaries Must Keep Pace
description: Election safeguards, persistent agents, on-device scam detection, and safety research computing; two conversations and coding-boundary research examine when to pause and who remains accountable.

coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirected to the Microsoft Source AI topic. Static and rendered lists lacked dates; the configured feed returned HTTP 410. Earlier alternative ten-entry AI-topic and Source feeds yielded seven candidates in total, but these feeds do not establish coverage of the configured entry point. This run’s targeted check received HTTP 403 from the configured AI page and both feeds. Earlier browser cards were readable but lacked list publication dates, and the ten-entry feeds provided insufficient window coverage. Date coverage remains incomplete.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remained dated September 23, 2025 and cannot establish no updates. The current qwen.ai/research page was checked again, including Load more: ten dated entries extended from September 20 back to June 15, 2026, with the sort menu set to newest first. The configured old entry point remains inconsistent with the current site. Other release channels were not fully checked; this does not establish no updates across all channels. Earlier page-config data were dated in 2025 and article retrieval was empty; supplemental HF model creation and GitHub pushes are not complete release coverage.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The configured homepage was retrieved and previous browser checks covered the visible products, but there was no independent dated news stream. Countdown readings differed from upstream records: the previous zero-day reading changed to 364 days, suggesting a possible reset rather than establishing an absolute release time. Supplementary HF organization and GitHub release checks did not establish a Step 5 Preview open-source release. Product names and countdowns are not publication dates. Window-date coverage remains incomplete.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: Earlier article data-date values ranged from September 25 to October 2, 2026, with no window entries; unrelated event dates were excluded and bodies were not read. In this run’s targeted check, HTTP 200 returned a JavaScript/human-verification page rather than a news list. The verification challenge was not bypassed. Current coverage could not be verified.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The configured homepage was available. Earlier checks distinguished announcements, 1,067 active venues, and 163 venues open for submissions. Homepage availability and these venue lists do not establish coverage of newly submitted papers. New papers were not searched venue by venue, so submission coverage remains incomplete.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Earlier upstream checks retained 12 window entries from the first AI page, with dated entries extending past the window start. Bodies were not read and syndication was not determined. This run’s two scripted attempts and the in-app browser all received HTTP 403 Forbidden. Upstream coverage before 05:00 Beijing is retained, but the final hour could not be independently checked.
